name: 3d-globe
blurb: Interactive 3D Earth globe with customizable markers and rotation.
description: An interactive Three.js-based 3D globe with optional Earth texture, atmosphere effects, orbital controls, and customizable markers placed at geographic coordinates.
use_when: Displaying geographic data, visualizing global operations, or creating impressive 3D globe visualizations.
avoid_when: On low-end devices, mobile without WebGL support, or when a flat map would suffice.
a11y: The 3D canvas itself is not accessible to screen readers; the globe is purely visual.
